title: Best habit app
body: This is one of the best habit apps I've ever used, notably because of the fact that its free. I also really like the pomodoro tracker. It would just be really great if you could have habits separated into parts (if a habit is meant to be done 3 times a day, check it off thrice, for example)
author: Harddifficulty

title: Great app but…
body: The app is close from being a 5 star, unfortunately there’s no export or sync feature
author: Manymanywhale

body: Eine 10/10 App! Wäre cool, wenn man ein Konto erstellen könnte und so sein Tracking einfach speichern könnte und auch über mehrere Geräte synchronisieren.
author: Nenzo

title: Krasser Value, Mega Design - und das gratis!
body: Danke! Ich schreibe sonst keine Reviews, aber diese App hat mich beeindruckt. Great Job 👏🏼
author: allnamesweregone

title: Awesome
body: This is a very nice app. It offers all the features for free and is very aesthetic at the same time. The app is very functional and also allows you to time your Focus. I also love the widgets! Great App, keep up the good work!
author: lshfjj
